fields.reasoning: The proposals were planned with the owner; a fresh interview would rewrite owner-made leaves with no owner present. A workflow step with skip = ["interview"] is the existing pattern (plan-bug includes plan, ship-change skips signoff), so no engine change is needed
fields.statement: The daemon's run on an uncovered proposal is a builtin plan-review workflow that includes plan and takes its interview as passed, so the run reviews the leaves already written and reaches the gate without re-planning them
fields.wording: (derived by the planner from the arbiter's Decision uncovered-proposals-get-plan-runs: the plan run reviews the existing leaves and reaches its gate)

fields.reasoning: A plan-review run that fails before its gate (milestone-check, a stuck review) journals no gated entry; under the arbiter's rule alone the daemon would start a new run on every poll. The failed run is already an inbox item with rhiza run resume --retry next, so the proposal is not silent
fields.statement: A plan run on the change set that ended failed and was not abandoned also covers it: the daemon does not start another, and the inbox lists the failure with its retry instead of an uncovered proposal; an abandoned run covers nothing
fields.wording: (derived by the planner from the arbiter's Decision uncovered-proposals-get-plan-runs, which names live runs and gated finished runs)

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... covers parsing plan-review (its first step after expansion is the included milestone-check, no interview step); a new cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/plan-review-workflow.txtar shows rhiza workflow describe plan-review listing no interview step and a rhiza run start --workflow plan-review --autonomous --no-wait on a proposed change set with a leaf, with the review and critic faked as the plan-workflow scripts fake them, reaching the gate, which accepts it under rule autonomous with rhiza.autonomy.accept auto; testscripts that list the builtin workflow names (go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(workflow-ls|plan-workflow)') pass, updated where they print the list. Touches internal/workflow/builtin/plan-review.toml, internal/workflow/workflow_test.go, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/plan-review-workflow.txtar
fields.statement: A builtin workflow plan-review (internal/workflow/builtin/plan-review.toml) is one workflow step that includes plan with skip = ["interview"], so rhiza run start <change> --workflow plan-review on a proposed change set with leaves enters at milestone-check, then the plan review, then the gate, and never opens a planner session

fields.acceptance: A new cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/daemon-plans-proposals.txtar (Rex faked, RHIZA_TEST_DETACH_LOG): a change set proposed with a leaf and no plan run makes rhiza daemon --once start one plan-review run naming it with --autonomous and the daemon's permission mode; a second poll while that start is pending starts nothing more; a proposed change set with no leaves, one a finished plan run's gated entry names, and one whose run ended failed start nothing; with --max-runs 1 and a ready accepted change set the proposal's start and the ship pick share the slot without exceeding it; under rhiza daemon pause nothing starts. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... and go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/daemon-' pass. Touches internal/api/daemon.go, internal/api/daemon_fold.go, internal/api/daemon_projects.go, internal/api/proposals.go, internal/api/proposals_test.go, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/daemon-plans-proposals.txtar
fields.statement: Each daemon poll starts, as a detached rhiza run start --foreground <change> --workflow plan-review --autonomous --permission-mode <the daemon's mode>, a plan run for every proposed change set with leaves that no plan run covers; a plan run covers it while a run on it is live or its start is pending and not yet journaled, when a finished plan run's latest gated entry names it, or when a run on it ended failed and was not abandoned; these starts count against max-runs after the resumes and before the ship picks, and stop under pause, low disk, the load and memory holds and a usage hold like any other start; one shared predicate (uncoveredProposals in internal/api) decides covered, for the daemon and the inbox

fields.acceptance: A new cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/inbox-uncovered-proposal.txtar: a change set proposed by hand with a leaf and no run shows in rhiza inbox --json as one accept item with that detail and next, under accept auto and under accept owner; once a plan run on it is live (or ended failed) the accept item is gone; once accepted it is gone; inbox-owner-run-accept.txtar still lists a gated proposal once. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... and go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(inbox-|ready)' pass. Touches internal/api/inbox.go, internal/api/inbox_test.go, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/inbox-uncovered-proposal.txtar
fields.statement: rhiza inbox lists every proposed change set that no plan run covers (uncoveredProposals) as an accept item, detail 'waiting for acceptance: no plan run covers it', next rhiza accept --rule owner --change <id>, whatever rhiza.autonomy.accept says; a proposal a gate left for the owner keeps its existing gated accept item, and no change set is listed twice; rhiza ready keeps its 'not accepted: proposed' reason
